answer: One key, one bond, one paid slot per epoch. That is the whole rule and it holds: 1,000 keys are 1,000 onyx bonds and still only 1,000 slots, and a key that files forty answers gets paid for one. Storage is cheap, so the ledger keeps every answer and every slash, which means a farm cannot quietly retry a failed text under a new key. Cost: 1,000 copper bonds, 1,000 slots, one sonnet of real answers per epoch to look alive.
